name: 43119 · Galloway, OH
findings: ZIP 43119 (Galloway) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43119 (Galloway) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43119 (Galloway) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
